topic: K-Stick and the Automatic Door That Only Lets His Shadow In
hook_text: Why does my shadow get VIP access?
background: Simple reusable building entrance hallway with one glass automatic sliding door
main_expression: Confused wide-eyed stare that turns into shocked disbelief
main_pose: K-Stick stands at the doorway, waving both arms, then points dramatically at his shadow
prop: Automatic sliding glass door with a small motion sensor
scene_1: K-Stick walks toward the automatic door confidently, but it stays closed. He looks at the sensor and waves one hand.
scene_2: He jumps, spins, and waves both arms like a human windmill, but the door still refuses to open. His shadow stretches across the sensor.
scene_3: K-Stick sighs and turns around to leave. The door suddenly opens behind him, apparently triggered by his shadow.
twist_ending: K-Stick turns back in surprise, but the door closes as his shadow enters. His shadow waves from inside while K-Stick presses his face against the glass.
video_title: When Your Shadow Gets Better Treatment
facebook_caption: K-Stick's shadow got inside before he did. Talk about showing him up!
youtube_description: K-Stick faces an automatic door with one strange rule: his shadow is welcome, but he is not! A quick, family-friendly stickman comedy reel with a silly twist ending.
